facts.text: I am an environmental science student. I study how people affect the environment.
I grew up in a small coastal city with several public parks. I now live on campus. My room has limited storage. There are few cars on campus before eight.
I prefer practical examples and dislike memorising definitions without understanding them.

I am taking part in a recycling audit at the university library. Our team records its waste and has a recycling point outside it. Some of our suggestions have been tried; the project is still ongoing.
